callouts.title: 命题
callouts.body: $\mathbb{R}^n$当中的$n$维球体的体积公式为$$\frac{\pi^{d/2}}{\Gamma(d/2+1)}r^d$$

if_problem.statement_en: The volume formula for the $d$-dimensional ball of radius $r$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is $$\frac{\pi^{d/2}}{\Gamma(d/2+1)}r^d.$$

callouts.title: 切片的本质
callouts.body:
如果$E$是$\mathbb{R}^{d_1}\times \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$当中的一个可测集合，那么对于几乎每个$y \in \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$都有切片,$$E^{y}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$
这种切片都是可测的集合，并且$m(E^{y})$是关于$y$的可测函数，并且$$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_2}}m(E^{y})\,dy$$同样的也有对几乎每个$x \in \mathbb{R}^{d_1}$都有切片,$$E_{x}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$这种切片都是可测的集合，并且$m(E_{x})$是关于$x$的可测函数，并且$$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_1}}m(E_{x})\,dx$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $E$ is a measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^{d_1}\times \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$, then for almost every $y \in \mathbb{R}^{d_2}$ the slice $$E^{y}=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^{d_1}:(x,y)\in E\}$$ is measurable, $m(E^{y})$ is a measurable function of $y$, and $$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_2}}m(E^{y})\,dy.$$ Similarly, for almost every $x \in \mathbb{R}^{d_1}$ the corresponding slices are measurable, the slice measure is measurable as a function of $x$, and $$m(E)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d_1}}m(E_{x})\,dx.$$

callouts.title: 由函数围成的区域的Lebesgue测度
callouts.body:
$f(x)$是$\mathbb{R}^k$上的一个非负的函数，集合$$A:=\{(x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^{k}\times \mathbb{R}:0\leq y \leq f(x)\}$$
那么这个集合的"面积"可以用积分来计算，公式如下:
$$\int_{\mathbb{R}^k} f(x)\,dx = m(A)$$
这里的$m$是集合的Lebesgue测度。

classification_result.english_title: Lebesgue Measure of a Region Bounded by a Function

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative function on $\mathbb{R}^k$, and define $$A:=\{(x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^{k}\times \mathbb{R}:0\leq y \leq f(x)\}.$$ Then the "area" of this set can be computed by integration, namely $$\int_{\mathbb{R}^k} f(x)\,dx = m(A),$$ where $m$ denotes Lebesgue measure.

classification_result.english_title: Generalization of the Gaussian Integral Formula
